blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) said Wednesday it had rescued a 9-year-old child from alleged online sexual abuse and exploitation. The suspect, who is over 30 years old, was brought to NBI headquarters in Pasay City following his arrest. NBI Director Melvin Matibag said the bureau’s Anti-Human Trafficking Division conducted the operation in Bulacan after a referral by the victim’s mother. The suspect allegedly persuaded the child to take sexually explicit photos and videos, which were sent through Facebook Messenger.
